title: hamster-animator
description: Turns Monte Carlo radiative transfer simulations of protoplanetary disks into animations with the group's HAMSTER code. You describe the disk, camera path, wavelengths and Stokes quantities; it works out which simulation runs are needed, runs them locally or on SLURM, caches every detector map and renders the video — including polarimetry, RGB composites and parameter sweeps.

title: IGSN Helper
description: Built for DAPHNE4NFDI's sample identifier service: drafts DataCite/IGSN metadata records from the free-text sample submissions researchers send in (DOCX or PDF) using a local LLM. Every extracted value is checked against the source document, validated and enriched via ORCID/ROR, and each record ships with a provenance file for the curator — plus a benchmark against curated records.
